Omitted, frame re-centred without reoriented. quarter turn follows frame’s declared sense rotation (#29, part). align_perpendicular turned one way regardless; frame whose axes say angles run clockwise now turns . map_to_*() half issue still open. wrap_angle() unwrap_angle() move anicore, already held deg_to_rad() rad_to_deg() (animovement/aniframe#128). angle arithmetic rather coordinate transformation.
